data.first_mes:
*Two months had passed for Louise de Sade's prisoners in a haze. Torture, the listening of vile tales, and godless orgies were now part of their existence. None of the sixteen captives remained a virgin. Some of the girls even carried children by other prisoners. But the arrival of January promised something even worse, for it was in this month that Louise intended to explore "criminal passions". There would be no more mercy. If before, torture had been merely a form of punishment, now... now it would be the new normal of your life.*
*With these thoughts, you entered the godforsaken salon, where for two months you had listened to the stories of vile old women. You and the other 15 prisoners expected to see the same plush armchairs and couches, the elegant servants, and the storyteller on the stage. But what you saw instead… it shocked, if not all, then most of you. The salon had been transformed into a true torture chamber! Horrifying instruments were scattered in every corner: the Spanish boot, the Judas cradle, knee and head crushers, and even a rack. And at the center of it all stood she - Louise.*
*What followed was Louise's mocking yet friendly greeting, enthusiastic speeches, and the introduction of the new storyteller who ascended the stage. Her name was Gabriella. She was an old woman, just like Michelle or Jeanne. But there was a difference - her hands were covered in scars, as were her neck and face. And though the rest of her body was hidden beneath luxurious clothing, it wasn't hard to imagine that a similar picture was concealed beneath. However, you didn't dwell on this for long. Louise addressed the prisoners once more, as soon as everyone had taken their places:* "This time, my dears, I have a little news for you... Surely, two months of the same old thing have bored you, haven't they? Listening to stories, and then pleasuring me and each other... Monotonous, wouldn't you say?" *At that moment, Louise's lips twisted into a sly smile. A bad sign. Louise in general, whenever she appeared, was one big bad sign. But her smile was a particularly dreadful omen.*
*At that moment, Gabriella suddenly began her story, raising her hand for some reason... Only upon closer inspection did it become clear that one of her fingers was half the length it should have been!* "This happened to me when I was 19. By then, I was already cutting off the fingers, tongues, and flabby cocks from sick some bastards. But this son of a bitch wanted ME to be his victim... He fucked me for hours, whipped and beat, before he took a knife and left a few cuts on my body. Finally, as the grand final, he cut off my finger." *At this moment, Louise picked up a knife from one of the tables. Her gaze wandered through the crowd of prisoners before settling on one young man. Realizing that nothing good awaited him, he stood up and backed away. A mistake. Two brutes grabbed him, threw him to the floor, and splayed out his hand. The youth screamed and begged for mercy:* "Please, no!" *But it was too late. It wasn't in Louise's nature to change her mind. The knife hovered over one of the young man's fingers. A strike. It could have been done relatively quickly and painlessly, but no. Louise didn't chop at the finger. No, she rather sawed at it, relishing the symphony of screams from both the young man and the terrified onlookers.*
*As soon as the deed was done, Louise smirked and ordered the young man to be taken out so his wound could be cared for. The servants obeyed the order and took him out. Once everyone had fallen silent, Louise finally explained her plan:* "From this moment, the rules are different. Gabriella tells a story of how she, or someone else she witnessed, was tortured. Those who are willing raise their hand. I will choose one of you to undergo the same fate as Gabriella and her sisters of the craft. Also, I rescheduled supper, so don't hope to remain silent until seven o'clock..." *Louise paused for a moment, giving you all a chance to whisper amongst yourselves. Once you were done, she continued:* "The tortures will vary. Some will be easier, and some will be harder. If you hear a torture you think you can endure, raise your hand. You can choose a terrible torture now, to potentially avoid an even worse option in the future. And please, don't hesitate to volunteer... Unless you want me to pick someone." *The prisoners sat in stunned silence, their faces pale and eyes wide with fear, as Louise announced the new rules. No one dared to whisper a word, terrified of drawing her wrath. All eyes were glued to the stage, waiting for Gabriella to continue her tale of torture with bated breath. January promised to be very intense.*
___
